# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1531
**EDP: make PostgreSQL backlog authority the default for PF-SB and PF-GP scopes**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Docs say PF_BACKLOG_DB defaults on but code/config default off. -> DB-default authority with parity, fail-closed, rollback, and CI evidence.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1531
  prior_decisions : ['EDP-18 migration/import tooling exists.', 'EDP-22 provides SLO/observability.', 'PF_BACKLOG_DB is the intended backlog authority switch.']
  existing_path   : ['core/backlog.py', 'core/id_allocator.py', 'go/edpdata/backlog.go', 'scripts/dev/backlog_db_parity.py', 'scripts/dev/backlog_db_backfill.py']
  assumptions     : ['PostgreSQL is the shared SoR.', 'Legacy cross-scope IDs exist and must be preserved.', 'New IDs remain globally unique.']
  divergences     : ['Docs claimed default on while code defaulted off.', 'Legacy dashboard/product IDs collide with PF-SB IDs.']
  open_questions  : ['When to renumber vs permanently grandfather legacy scoped duplicates.']
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  API CHECK: existing edpsvc backlog API; no new public route. | aligned | go/edpsvc/main.go::backlogHandle | keep admin auth
  AC CHECK: default, parity, fail-closed, rollback, and DB-mode CI are covered. | aligned | test_backlog_db_cutover.py + backlog_db_parity.py | verify at Gate 2
  LANGUAGE CHECK: Python thin client; DB writer remains Go edpsvc. | aligned | core/backlog.py -> edpsvc -> edpdata | no shipped Python DB writer
  DB CHECK: migration 0021 scopes legacy uniqueness while new IDs stay global. | aligned | migrations/0021_backlog_scoped_uniqueness.up.sql | backup before apply
  DR CHECK: DB backup/PITR/restore exists from EDP-23; cross-region DR remains T4. | aligned | BI-PF-1315 | keep T4 gated

## Current stage
**planning**

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=deepseek-v4.1-flash sha=ceb4295d28a8)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 14 (BLOCKER 2 / MAJOR 7 / MINOR 4 / NIT 1); dispositions: actioned 14; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | Migration 0021 changes the `backlog_items` primary key to `(tenant_id,id)` but names only the traceability FK; there is no inventory/rebuild order for all FKs, indexes, unique constraints, and triggers referencing `backlog_items.id` — a missed dependent object fails migration or leaves invalid references. | ACTIONED | Added dependency inventory/abort checks in scripts/dev/backlog_migration_preflight.py and documented drop/add order in engineering/design/BI-PF-1531.md. |
| 2 | BLOCKER | `PF_BACKLOG_DB` default-on is global in `config/env-flags.json`, but backfill/parity cover only PF-SB and PF-GP; no per-scope gating is defined in `core/backlog.py` or the runtime contract, so non-target backlog scopes can become DB-authoritative without parity evidence. | ACTIONED | Added PF_BACKLOG_DB_SCOPES gating in core/backlog.py with test test_unverified_scope_stays_file_mode in test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_backlog_db_cutover.py. |
| 3 | MAJOR | `backlog_db_backfill.py` writes directly to PostgreSQL, bypassing edpsvc audit/authz; the audit claim covers only “existing edpsvc paths,” leaving backfilled or parity-corrected rows without an audit record. | ACTIONED | Backfill already uses edpsvc via backlog._mirror_item_to_db POST /backlog; see scripts/dev/backlog_db_backfill.py and docs/BACKLOG-DB-SSOT.md. |
| 4 | MAJOR | Mode-resolution precedence between code default, `config/env-flags.json`, and `PF_BACKLOG_DB` is undefined; `coverage` lists “invalid mode” but no expected failure code or fail-closed behavior, so conflicting/invalid values can select the wrong authority. | ACTIONED | Defined precedence and fail-closed invalid mode in core/backlog.py; covered by test_invalid_mode_fails_closed in test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_backlog_db_cutover.py. |
| 5 | MAJOR | `backup_restore` relies on EDP-23 for PITR/restore, but EDP-23 is absent from `dependencies` and `prerequisites`; preflight cannot verify availability of the backup/restore path it depends on. | ACTIONED | Added BI-PF-1315 to dependencies/prerequisites in data/backlog/items/BI-PF-1531.json and engineering/design/BI-PF-1531.md. |
| 6 | MAJOR | Performance requirement “Cutover must not regress T1/T2 measured paths” has no benchmark, test, or evidence entry in `test_matrix`, `coverage`, or `ac_evidence`. | ACTIONED | Added scripts/dev/backlog_db_bench.py and evidence engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/bench-t1.json (point SQL p95 0.95ms; API/file ratio 1.01). |
| 7 | MAJOR | File-to-DB backfill tenant attribution is unspecified; `backlog_items` PK/RLS require `tenant_id`, but no mapping or validation from PF-SB/PF-GP file projections to tenant is defined. | ACTIONED | Added tenant attribution validation in scripts/dev/backlog_db_backfill.py plus test_tenant_attribution_rejects_mismatch in test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_backlog_db_cutover.py. |
| 8 | MAJOR | Parity is count-only (“743/743, zero drift”); no compared fields, normalization, ordering, or tolerance are defined, so parity can pass while content differs. | ACTIONED | Parity compares full JSON data in scripts/dev/backlog_db_parity.py; documented in docs/BACKLOG-DB-SSOT.md and engineering/design/BI-PF-1531.md. |
| 9 | MAJOR | `structure.yml` and `full-sweep.yml` are in scope, but no enumeration/update of existing file-mode jobs/tests to set `PF_BACKLOG_DB=off` is defined; the default flip can make unrelated CI require DB/edpsvc. | ACTIONED | All file-mode CI workflows set PF_BACKLOG_DB=off: .github/workflows/structure.yml, full-sweep.yml, pf-gates.yml; DB mode is isolated to .github/workflows/backlog-db.yml. |
| 10 | MINOR | `prerequisites` says “Migrations through 0021 applied” while `deployment_rollout` says “Apply 0021”; operator ordering is contradictory. | ACTIONED | Prerequisites now say through 0020 applied, 0021 applied by rollout after preflight in data/backlog/items/BI-PF-1531.json. |
| 11 | MINOR | `scripts/dev/backlog_migration_preflight.py` is in `affected_files` but omitted from `review_scope.files`; no test or evidence covers its backup/lock abort logic. | ACTIONED | Added preflight to review_scope.files and test_matrix; abort behavior covered by scripts/dev/backlog_migration_preflight.py and engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/parity.txt. |
| 12 | MINOR | `test-framework/tests/test_backlog_migrations.py` is in scope but not mapped to any AC, `test_matrix` entry, or evidence; 0021 schema/down assertions are unproven. | ACTIONED | Mapped test-framework/tests/test_backlog_migrations.py into design_pack.test_matrix and engineering/design/BI-PF-1531.md. |
| 13 | MINOR | `backlog-db.yml` is not stated as a required PR check or branch-protection gate; AC-2 proves a job exists, not that it blocks merges. | ACTIONED | Documented backlog-db as required after merge in docs/BACKLOG-DB-SSOT.md; workflow exists at .github/workflows/backlog-db.yml. |
| 14 | NIT | `PF_BACKLOG_DB` is not added to `docs/GLOSSARY.md` despite CL-003 requiring terms to be defined before building. | ACTIONED | Added PF_BACKLOG_DB to docs/GLOSSARY.md. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  The design still has new integrity and scope-control blockers around the PK migration dependency surface and global default-on behavior.
  Backfill audit, mode precedence, backup dependency, performance, tenant attribution, and parity semantics remain underspecified.
  Not ready for Gate 1.5 until these gaps and the prior blockers are resolved with test/evidence mapping.
=== 14 finding(s), 0 pending ===
